title: My brain
examples: What part of my body helps me think?
Does my brain help me move my arms?
How does my brain know when I feel happy?

explain.say: Your brain is like the control center for your whole body.
It helps you think when you learn new things in school.
It helps you feel happy or maybe a little sad too.
It tells your muscles when it is time to run and jump.
Your brain is the boss that controls all these jobs.
When you ride your bike, your brain tells your legs to pedal.

faq.q: What is the brain's main job?
faq.a: The brain is the body's control center. It tells everything else what to do.

faq.q: Does my brain help me feel things?
faq.a: Yes, the brain manages your feelings. It helps you know if you are happy or sad.
asks: Is feeling part of the brain's job?

faq.q: Does the brain only help me think?
faq.a: No, it also helps you move your body. It sends messages to your muscles.
asks: Can I move without my brain?

faq.q: Do I need to sleep for my brain?
faq.a: Yes, sleeping helps your brain rest and remember things you learned.
asks: Is sleep good for my brain?

faq.a: You should be careful with your head to keep your brain safe. Always wear a helmet when biking.

facts: The brain controls all your actions and thoughts.
It helps you understand what you see and hear.
Feelings like joy and fear are managed by the brain.
Movement starts with signals from the brain.

quiz.say: Which job is the brain NOT responsible for?
quiz.why: Breathing is controlled by automatic systems, not just the main control center we focus on.

wrong.0: This is a main job of the brain.
wrong.1: The brain is responsible for managing emotions.
wrong.2: The brain sends signals to make you move.

quiz.say: When you learn a new word, which part of your brain is working?
quiz.why: Learning and understanding new things is what we call thinking.

wrong.0: Breathing is a life process, not a thinking process.
wrong.2: Moving is about your muscles, not learning words.
wrong.3: Feeling is about your emotions, not your words.

quiz.say: If you want to jump high, what does the brain do?

options.show: Sends signals to your leg muscles
options.say: Sends signals to your leg muscles

quiz.why: The brain sends the instructions or signals that tell your muscles to work.

wrong.0: Muscle strength comes from practice, not just a brain signal.
wrong.1: Thinking is what you do before or after the jump.
wrong.3: Feeling happy is a result, not the action of jumping.
